m: [n./phrase] ; चिक्कस, पिसान वा रोटी-तैयारी सम्बन्धी शब्द।
e: Fine powdery foodstuff obtained by grinding and sifting the meal of a cereal grain; food made from dough of flour or meal and usually raised with yeast or baking powder and then baked; the activity of putting or setting in order in advance of some act or purpose.
